hooks.text: A single explosion outshone twenty Milky Ways combined.
One cosmic blast released more energy than our Sun's lifetime.
A monstrous black hole shredded a wandering star.

title: The Explosion Brighter Than Twenty Galaxies
description: Discover ASASSN-15lh, a cosmic explosion so powerful it briefly outshone twenty Milky Ways combined.

beats.text: A single explosion outshone twenty Milky Ways combined.
beats.visual: Artist's impression of a superluminous supernova in a distant galaxy

beats.text: The All Sky survey found this flash in Chile.
beats.visual: ASAS-SN telescope units at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory, Chile
subjects: All Sky Automated Survey for SuperNovae

beats.text: It blazed six hundred billion times brighter than our Sun.
beats.visual: Artist's illustration of a hypernova explosion in space

beats.text: In weeks, it released more energy than the Sun's ten billion years.
beats.visual: NASA Swift Gamma-Ray Burst Mission spacecraft in orbit

beats.text: Astronomers think a supermassive black hole destroyed a wandering star.
beats.visual: Artist's impression of spaghettification by a black hole
queries: star being stretched by black hole

beats.text: That extreme gravity ripped the star apart in a violent flare.
beats.visual: Artist's impression of a spinning Kerr black hole accretion disk
queries: spinning black hole accretion disk artist

beats.text: Such death glows brighter than twenty Milky Ways combined.
beats.visual: Giant elliptical galaxy captured by the Hubble Space Telescope
